def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_sep = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_sep = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    divvals = {grid[i][0] for i in row_sep} | {grid[0][j] for j in col_sep}
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w)
                     if i not in row_sep and j not in col_sep)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v in counts if v != bg and v not in divvals)
    rb, cb = [-1] + row_sep + [h], [-1] + col_sep + [w]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[i][j] == marker for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d)) > 1 else bg
             for c,d in zip(cb,cb[1:])]
            for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:])]
